briefs: C6 (verify_quote, hl_send_to_intents, sol_sign_rescue, evm_usdc_to_intents, E_QUOTE_SIGNATURE / E_QUOTE_FIELDS / E_RESCUE_CAP), C8 (fund_venue, payouts to the contract)
references: live dry quotes from https://1click.chaindefuser.com/v0/quote fetched 2026-10-27
signature_rule: Ed25519 by public_key over the UTF-8 bytes of base58(sha256(canonical_json)); canonical_json = json-stable-stringify (sorted keys, no spaces, undefined dropped) of the signed request fields, the signed quote fields and timestamp. The relayer passes canonical_json as the exact string; the contract hashes it as is, then parses it.
finding_app_fees: appFees is not in the signed message (the SDK drops it), and 1Click echoes an appFees entry of its own even when the request sends none. The contract therefore never sees appFees and cannot refuse them; the only signed evidence of fees is amountOut / minAmountOut. See signed_cost_e8 on each quote.
dry_note: These are dry quotes: no deposit address exists, so production must refuse them (case "dry quote in production"). The field cases run with ctx.dry_ok = true so the other rules can be tested on real signatures.

deskEvm.role: desk EVM address: Hyperliquid master, Orderly account owner, EIP-3009 `from`

deskSol.role: desk Ed25519 key: Solana authority (Phoenix) and the desk's Orderly key

orderlyReceiver.role: the desk's pinned Orderly exclusive receiver address on Arbitrum

contractNear.role: the gimbal contract as a NEAR implicit account (hex of this public key)

strangerEvm.role: an EVM address the desk does not own (attacks, tampered quotes)

strangerSol.role: a Solana address the desk does not own (attacks)

key_note: Every address in these quotes belongs to a public test key (see the README); they are synthetic and must never be funded.
field_rule: signature (E_QUOTE_SIGNATURE) -> live quote: dry refused unless ctx.dry_ok, live needs depositAddress (E_QUOTE_FIELDS) -> originAsset of the method: sol_sign_rescue Solana USDC, hl_send_to_intents HyperCore USDC, evm_usdc_to_intents Arbitrum USDC, fund_venue USDC on NEAR -> refundTo = desk Solana authority / desk EVM / desk EVM / the contract -> recipientType DESTINATION_CHAIN -> recipient: pinned Orderly receiver (Arbitrum USDC, minAmountOut >= 6000000), desk EVM (HyperCore USDC), desk Solana authority (Solana USDC), the contract (USDC on NEAR, customRecipientMsg exactly {"desk_id":"<desk>"}); anything else E_QUOTE_FIELDS -> deadline > now -> rescue methods: amountIn <= remaining_cap_usd * 10^decimals(origin) (E_RESCUE_CAP). EVM addresses compare case-insensitively, others exactly.
